{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA orders: those with revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']

# Count completed orders excluding QA orders
total_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (~df.index.isin(qa_orders.index))].shape[0]

total_refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]

total_rows = len(df)

# Verify: completed (excluding QA) + refunded + QA = total
total_verified = total_completed + total_refunded + len(qa_orders)

print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(f"Completed orders (excluding QA): {total_completed}")
print(f"Refunded orders: {total_refunded}")
print(f"Total rows: {total_rows}")
print(f"Verification (completed + refunded + QA): {total_verified}")

# Final check
assert total_verified == total_rows, "Sum does not match total rows""}
